_comment: "Destroy UP TO 3 Might tokens. Create a Toughness token FOR EACH TOKEN DESTROYED THIS WAY." Both halves were wrong in the same direction, so the card was strictly better than printed: DESTROY_TOKEN did not read max_destroy and destroyed exactly ONE, while CREATE_TOKEN made THREE Toughness unconditionally -- three tokens for one. DESTROY_TOKEN now destroys up to N and records what it took, and the create side counts that instead of assuming the maximum.
